short_name: Arabidopsis hormone-stress multi-omics causal interaction metadata
description: Flat per-record metadata schema for transcriptomic and metabolomic measurements from Arabidopsis thaliana exposed to environmental stress and altered hormone levels, including causal interaction annotations and literature evidence fields.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record or sample record.

organism_scientific_name.descr: Scientific name of the organism; for this dataset typically Arabidopsis thaliana.

organism_taxon_id.descr: NCBI Taxonomy identifier for the organism, e.g., 3702 for Arabidopsis thaliana.

ecotype_or_genotype.descr: Plant ecotype, accession, or genotype used in the experiment, e.g., Col-0, Ler.

plant_age_days.descr: Age of the plant at the time of treatment or sampling, in days.

developmental_stage.descr: Developmental stage at sampling, using a standardized stage name or description.

tissue_type.descr: Plant tissue analyzed, e.g., leaf, root, shoot, whole seedling.

sample_condition_description.descr: Free-text description of the biological sample and treatment context.

omics_assay_type.descr: Type of assay used for the record, e.g., RNA-seq, LC-MS, or multi-omics.

assay_platform.descr: Instrument or analytical platform used, e.g., Illumina NovaSeq, Orbitrap LC-MS.

library_preparation_protocol.descr: Brief description or name of RNA-seq library preparation protocol, if applicable.

metabolomics_extraction_protocol.descr: Brief description or name of the metabolite extraction protocol, if applicable.

stress_type.descr: Environmental stress applied, e.g., drought, salinity, heat, cold, oxidative stress.

stress_intensity_value.descr: Numeric magnitude of the stress treatment, if quantifiable, such as NaCl concentration in mM or temperature shift in degrees Celsius.

stress_intensity_units.descr: Units for stress_intensity_value, e.g., mM, degC, %, MPa.

stress_duration_value.descr: Duration of the stress treatment before sampling.

stress_duration_units.descr: Units for stress_duration_value, e.g., min, h, d.

stress_onset_time.descr: Time point when stress was initiated, relative to the experiment start if relevant.

hormone_name.descr: Name of the plant hormone whose level was altered or measured, e.g., ABA, auxin, salicylic acid, jasmonic acid, ethylene.

hormone_level_value.descr: Measured or applied hormone level or concentration.

hormone_level_units.descr: Units for hormone_level_value, e.g., nM, uM, mg/L, arbitrary units.

hormone_treatment_type.descr: Type of hormone perturbation, e.g., exogenous application, inhibition, overexpression, endogenous measurement.

hormone_treatment_duration.descr: Duration of hormone exposure or perturbation before sampling.

hormone_treatment_duration_units.descr: Units for hormone_treatment_duration, e.g., min, h, d.

gene_or_transcript_id.descr: Identifier of the gene or transcript measured in the RNA-seq component, such as TAIR locus or transcript ID.

gene_symbol.descr: Standard gene symbol, if available, for the transcriptomic feature.

gene_expression_value.descr: Observed gene expression abundance or normalized expression value.

gene_expression_units.descr: Units or normalization basis for gene_expression_value, e.g., TPM, FPKM, counts, log2FC.

metabolite_name.descr: Name of the measured metabolite in the LC-MS component, using a standard compound name when possible.

metabolite_identifier.descr: Database identifier for the metabolite, e.g., HMDB, KEGG, PubChem, or internal ID.

metabolite_abundance_value.descr: Observed metabolite abundance, concentration, or normalized intensity.

metabolite_abundance_units.descr: Units for metabolite_abundance_value, e.g., uM, nmol/g FW, ion counts, log2FC.

fold_change_value.descr: Effect size relative to control for a gene or metabolite measurement.

fold_change_type.descr: Directionality or format of fold change, e.g., treated vs control, log2 fold change.

statistical_significance_p_value.descr: P-value associated with the differential expression or abundance change.

false_discovery_rate.descr: Multiple-testing corrected significance value, e.g., FDR or q-value.

causal_interaction_source_entity.descr: Upstream entity in the causal relationship, such as a hormone, gene, protein, or metabolite.

causal_interaction_target_entity.descr: Downstream entity affected by the source entity.

interaction_type.descr: Type of causal interaction, e.g., activation, inhibition, repression, induction, feedback.

interaction_direction.descr: Direction of influence, e.g., positive, negative, bidirectional.

interaction_context.descr: Biological or experimental context in which the interaction was observed, e.g., drought plus ABA treatment.

causal_support_level.descr: Strength of causal evidence, e.g., inferred, literature-supported, experimentally validated.

is_literature_supported.descr: Whether the interaction is supported by existing published studies.

reference_title.descr: Title of the supporting study or publication.

reference_authors.descr: Primary authors or abbreviated citation for the supporting reference.

reference_year.descr: Publication year of the supporting reference.

reference_journal.descr: Journal or source where the supporting study was published.

reference_doi.descr: Digital Object Identifier of the supporting reference.

reference_pubmed_id.descr: PubMed identifier of the supporting reference, if available.

reference_evidence_summary.descr: Short summary of the evidence from the reference that supports the interaction.

experimental_control_description.descr: Description of the control condition used for comparison.

replicate_number.descr: Biological or technical replicate number for the record.

sample_collection_date.descr: Date when the sample was collected.

data_processing_pipeline.descr: Name or description of the computational pipeline used to process the raw RNA-seq or LC-MS data.

normalization_method.descr: Method used to normalize expression or abundance values, e.g., DESeq2, TMM, quantile normalization.

quality_control_passed.descr: Indicates whether the record passed predefined quality control criteria.
